source_bundle_reference.note: The existing public source-training bundle is referenced by repository-relative path and SHA-256; its 14 MB evidence snapshot is not duplicated here.

evidence.baseline_scope: The fixed small random forest is a reproducible nonlinear comparator, not an upper bound on learned-policy quality; no hyperparameter search. A failed superiority gate does not establish equivalence or lack of compiler-information value.

compiler_features.ir_instruction_count: Static LLVM instruction lines in harness_kernel only
compiler_features.ir_loop_metadata_count: Distinct LLVM loop metadata IDs attached within harness_kernel
compiler_features.ir_max_vector_bits: Maximum fixed vector lane count times element bits in harness_kernel; zero if none
compiler_features.ir_vector_instruction_count: Static instructions with fixed vector types or vector-specific opcodes in harness_kernel
compiler_features.object_bytes: Whole kernel object file size including metadata; not native text size or runtime cost
compiler_features.vectorize_remark_count: Distinct tagged successful loop-vectorize remarks from object compilation
compiler_features.vectorize_remark_max_interleave: Maximum successful interleave count, zero absent
compiler_features.vectorize_remark_max_vf: Maximum successful vectorization factor, zero absent

evidence.corpus_selection: Six dimension/padding settings deliberately fixed before any fresh compilation, inference or timing to cover small, square, tall, wide, deep-reduction and shallow-reduction shapes. Values are listed explicitly in cases; not randomly sampled from a deployment population. For each setting, choose four of rrr,rrc,rcr,rcc,crr,crc,ccr,ccc using Python random.Random(20261020).sample in listed setting order. Exact specs are disjoint from all prior experiment manifests.
evidence.hypothesis: Compiler-informed Jev improves fresh contraction schedule choices beyond generic cheap selectors, including a fixed nonlinear predictor, with consistent expected single-call quality across repeated provider responses.
evidence.interpretation: Success supports middle-tier decision quality on one generated operation/CPU, not useful third-tier routing, application generalization, human maintenance savings or a complete escalation architecture. If a generic cheap predictor matches Jev, report a cheap learned-policy candidate without forcing escalation. Failure or variability is a result, not permission to add handwritten exceptions.
evidence.maintenance: Report selector expression, feature and action counts, fixed hyperparameters, learned labels/model size, prompt, provider calls, and compilation/extraction/fit/inference costs. No adaptation-effort claim.
evidence.measurement: Every fresh case and all seven labels, two independent interleaved11-round blocks. No filtering by model advantage. All choices and fitted policies frozen before timing. No concurrent compilation, tests or model fitting during timing.
evidence.name: feedback-replication-v1-recovery
evidence.packet: Unchanged informed compiler-feedback decision packet; no test group labels, timings, paths, replicate ID or answers from other models. Three independent valid responses per identical packet, separately cached and all obtained before any timing pilot. Never retry a valid choice. Record bounded failed attempts.

pre_timing_amendment.import: Copy the 20 original provider cache files byte-for-byte into a new output before preparation. Frozen packet validation must match every imported slot. Rebuild fresh cases under new provenance; no old performance observations exist.
pre_timing_amendment.reason: Jev invalid_response at replication-square-rrr replicate2; the adapter retained reason only, so the precise failed schema check and rejected-response usage are unavailable
pre_timing_amendment.rule: At most three total attempts per slot for invalid or unavailable responses, including the initial failed attempt. Apply equally to all slots; preserve every attempt; never retry valid choices; exhaustion aborts without dropping cases. No parser, schema, prompt, control, corpus or gate changes. Primary quality is for this bounded-retry provider policy; report failures and total requests separately.

evidence.primary_success: In each block separately, expected single-call Jev runtime beats each of constant,stride,nearest_neighbor,ridge,forest beyond max(log1p(.02),3*maximum paired MADlog), positive in at least4of6 structural groups. Group-balanced geometric ratios after arithmetic averaging across three provider-selected runtimes per case and round. No best-of-three selection. Report every comparison and individual replicate.
evidence.provider_variability: Three distinct HTTP requests per packet with identical model/configuration and no local response reuse across replicate slots. Provider-side caching/determinism and statistical independence are not established. Report per-replicate comparisons and choice agreement, not population-level stability or confidence intervals. The arithmetic response average is an empirical three-request estimate.
evidence.stop: Fail closed on correctness or provenance failure; preserve all failures and unfavourable cases. Do not alter cases/features/controls/prompts/success gates after observing fresh timings.
evidence.training: All36 prior compiler-feedback cases, first timing block only, six unique orders each. Targets log(runtime/canonical stock), same42 numeric features. Fit constant,1NN,ridge alpha1,random forest with fixed parameters. No new test outcomes enter training, tuning, feature selection or prompt construction. Prior held-out cases are now training only.

The compiler fields are static evidence from optimized LLVM IR and the compiled kernel object for each action; they are not runtime measurements.

shift-audit-wide-rrr.task: Choose a loop order for C_ij=sum_k((A_ik XOR uint32(salt))*B_kj) modulo 2^32. C starts at zero; A, B and C are disjoint uint32 buffers. Preserve the exact result. Minimize native runtime. The target is Apple M3 with a 128-bit NEON vector unit. Numeric axes are i=0,j=1,k=2; action fields encode outer, middle and inner loop axes. The compiler fields are static evidence from optimized LLVM IR and the compiled kernel object for each action; they are not runtime measurements.

evidence.corpus_selection: Six dimension/padding settings deliberately fixed before any fresh compilation, inference or timing to cover small, square, tall, wide, deep-reduction and shallow-reduction shapes. Values are listed explicitly in cases; not randomly sampled from a deployment population. For each setting, choose four of rrr,rrc,rcr,rcc,crr,crc,ccr,ccc using Python random.Random(20261020).sample in listed setting order. Exact specs are disjoint from all prior experiment manifests.
evidence.hypothesis: Compiler-informed Jev improves fresh contraction schedule choices beyond generic cheap selectors, including a fixed nonlinear predictor, with consistent expected single-call quality across repeated provider responses.
evidence.interpretation: Success supports middle-tier decision quality on one generated operation/CPU, not useful third-tier routing, application generalization, human maintenance savings or a complete escalation architecture. If a generic cheap predictor matches Jev, report a cheap learned-policy candidate without forcing escalation. Failure or variability is a result, not permission to add handwritten exceptions.
evidence.maintenance: Report selector expression, feature and action counts, fixed hyperparameters, learned labels/model size, prompt, provider calls, and compilation/extraction/fit/inference costs. No adaptation-effort claim.
evidence.measurement: Every fresh case and all seven labels, two independent interleaved11-round blocks. No filtering by model advantage. All choices and fitted policies frozen before timing. No concurrent compilation, tests or model fitting during timing.
evidence.name: feedback-replication-v1-recovery
evidence.packet: Unchanged informed compiler-feedback decision packet; no test group labels, timings, paths, replicate ID or answers from other models. Three independent valid responses per identical packet, separately cached and all obtained before any timing pilot. Never retry a valid choice. Record bounded failed attempts.

pre_timing_amendment.import: Copy the 20 original provider cache files byte-for-byte into a new output before preparation. Frozen packet validation must match every imported slot. Rebuild fresh cases under new provenance; no old performance observations exist.
pre_timing_amendment.reason: Jev invalid_response at replication-square-rrr replicate2; the adapter retained reason only, so the precise failed schema check and rejected-response usage are unavailable
pre_timing_amendment.rule: At most three total attempts per slot for invalid or unavailable responses, including the initial failed attempt. Apply equally to all slots; preserve every attempt; never retry valid choices; exhaustion aborts without dropping cases. No parser, schema, prompt, control, corpus or gate changes. Primary quality is for this bounded-retry provider policy; report failures and total requests separately.

evidence.primary_success: In each block separately, expected single-call Jev runtime beats each of constant,stride,nearest_neighbor,ridge,forest beyond max(log1p(.02),3*maximum paired MADlog), positive in at least4of6 structural groups. Group-balanced geometric ratios after arithmetic averaging across three provider-selected runtimes per case and round. No best-of-three selection. Report every comparison and individual replicate.
evidence.provider_variability: Three distinct HTTP requests per packet with identical model/configuration and no local response reuse across replicate slots. Provider-side caching/determinism and statistical independence are not established. Report per-replicate comparisons and choice agreement, not population-level stability or confidence intervals. The arithmetic response average is an empirical three-request estimate.
evidence.stop: Fail closed on correctness or provenance failure; preserve all failures and unfavourable cases. Do not alter cases/features/controls/prompts/success gates after observing fresh timings.
evidence.training: All36 prior compiler-feedback cases, first timing block only, six unique orders each. Targets log(runtime/canonical stock), same42 numeric features. Fit constant,1NN,ridge alpha1,random forest with fixed parameters. No new test outcomes enter training, tuning, feature selection or prompt construction. Prior held-out cases are now training only.
